messages:
kai.l: Heads-up: We're publishing the Auth Bridge deprecation timeline. Over the next 6 weeks we'll retire the legacy auth-bridge (Okta passthrough) and migrate CI, self-hosted runners, and a handful of automation bots to the Identity Gateway (idgw). Full plan: https://go.internal/auth-bridge-deprecate

mira.s: Timeline + visible impacts? who needs to act now?

kai.l: TL;DR:
- Week 0 (now): announcement and preflight guidance
- Week 2: run preflight checks in `redwood-ci-staging` (instructions in doc)
- Week 4: restricted mode - new tokens issued only via idgw, legacy tokens silently expire
- Week 6: hard deprecation of auth-bridge

Immediate impacts:
- Any workflow or bot using hardcoded PATs or relying on auth-bridge token exchange will break once restricted mode starts.
- Self-hosted runners must update runner-agent >=0.11.0 to support idgw pinning.

francesca.devex: I'll spin up a migration checklist and PR template for repo-owners. Can we add a small sample for bots that call the API?

kai.l: Yes: sample bot in `infra/bots/auth-sample` and a helper script `migrate-bot.sh` in the doc.

oliver.sre: Rollback strategy if we see systemic breakage?

kai.l: We keep a 30-minute re-route to the auth-bridge during the restricted-mode window. Rollback commands in runbook with exact k8s and ingress edits. We'll require a postmortem for any unexpected broad failure.

sec-bot: Security note: any user-scoped PATs found in repos will be revoked during Week 4. Please run `go/internal/secrets-scan --org redwood --threshold 1` and fix flagged tokens.

mira.s: Monitoring panels to watch: `auth.token.errors`, `runner.register.latency`, `ci.workflow.fail_pct`. Alerts: Pager for P1; Slack for P2.

ci-agent-bot: Preflight gate: run `./ci-preflight.sh --idgw --org redwood-ci-staging` and paste results in this thread. Required success rate >= 99% for canary.

francesca.devex: Office hours scheduled Wed 14:00 UTC in #eng-platform to help repo owners. I'll post the checklist link there.

kai.l: Action items recap:
- Dev teams: run preflight in staging by end of Week 2; remove/rotate hardcoded PATs
- Runner owners: upgrade agent to v0.11.0
- Bot owners: migrate to sample helper and verify token exchange
- Security: run secrets scan and prepare revoke list

mira.s: I'll do a readiness sweep at start of Week 3. Post blockers here and tag @oliver.sre for urgent infra issues. :thumbsup:
